spans.s:
युज् 1. युज् (connected with rt. 2. यु),
cl. 7. P. A. युनक्ति, युङ्क्ते (said to be
also cl. 1. P. योजति), युयोज, युयुजे (

rd pl.
युयुज्रे), योक्ष्यति, -ते, अयुजत् or अयौक्षीत्,
अयुक्त (epic forms (अनु)युञ्जसे, 3rd sing. युञ्जते,
अयुञ्जम्, युञ्जत; Vedic forms युजे, युनजते,
योज, योजम्, योजते, युयोजते, अयुजि, अयुज्रन्,
युजन्त, अयुक्षत), योक्तुम् (Ved. Inf. युजे),
to yoke, join, attach, join together, unite, fasten,
connect, add; to harness, put to (horses, &c.); to
join one's self to, come into union or conjunction
with (e. g. रोहिणीं शशी युनक्ति, the moon unites
with Rohiṇī); to adhere, cleave to (A.); to apply,
fit, fix; to use, employ, make use of; to make
ready, prepare, fit out, arrange; to appoint, institute;
to enjoin, charge; to put on, place on, fix on, fasten
on (as an arrow on a bow-string); to put in, infix,
insert, inject; to fix the mind (मनस्, चित्तम्, &c.)
on anything (loc.); to direct, turn, bend the thoughts
(चिन्ताम्, &c.) towards any object (loc.); to concen-
trate or fix the mind (in order to obtain union with
the Universal Spirit); to be absorbed or deeply en-
gaged in meditation, meditate, think upon; to join
[]
or connect with (with inst.), bring into the posses-
sion of, furnish or endow with (with inst.), bestow
anything (acc.) upon any one (loc. or gen.), grant,
confer: Pass. युज्यते (ep. also युज्यति), Aor. अयोजि,
to be yoked or joined; to be fastened or united; to
be harnessed; to be put to; to join or connect one's
self with, be in conjunction with, to adhere, cleave
to; to be applied; to be fit or proper, to be adapted
or suitable, to be right; to be made ready or pre-
pared; to be placed or fixed on, to be directed
towards; to be absorbed or immersed in; to medi-
tate; to be joined or endowed with or possessed of
(with inst.); to participate in, attain to, possess,
obtain (with inst.): Caus. योजयति, -यते, -यितुम्,
Aor. अयूयुजत्, to cause to join or unite; to cause
union or conjunction; to yoke, harness, put to; to
join, unite, fasten, connect, add; to apply, fix, fit,
place, lay; to use, make use of; to prepare, arrange,
equip, undertake, execute; to appoint, employ, com-
mission, appoint to (with loc.); to fix on, place on
or in; to fix the mind (मनस् or आत्मानम्) on,
direct the thoughts &c. to (with loc.); to concen-
trate the attention on, be immersed or engrossed in
(with loc.); to furnish or endow with (with inst.);
to make to possess or partake of (with inst.), cause
to share in, present with, bestow upon; to urge or
incite any one (acc.) to anything (dat.), to excite,
instigate; to surround; to think little of, esteem
lightly, despise (A.): Desid. युयुक्षति, -ते, to
wish to join or unite, to desire to appoint, to desire
to place in any employment or occupation; to wish
to fix or place; to be about to place or put on; to
intend to fix (the mind) on; to wish to be absorbed
in: Intens. योयुज्यते, योयुजीति, योयोक्ति; [cf. Gr.
ζεύγ-νυ-μι (ἐ-ζύγ-η-ν), ζεῦγ-μα, ζεῦγ-ος, ὁμό-ζυξ,
σύ-ζυξ, ζυγ-ό-ς, ζυγ-ό-ν; Lat. ju-n-g-o, ju-men-
tu-m, con-jux, jug-u-m, jugeru-m, juxta; Goth.
juk, ga-juk; Old Germ. joh, joch; Angl. Sax. geo-
can, geoce; Slav. ig-o; Lith. junga-s, jung-iu.]

2. युज्, क्, क्, क् (often at the end of comps.;
when uncompounded the strong cases ought to
have a nasal inserted, e. g. युङ्, युञ्जौ, युञ्जस्,
युञ्जम्, युञ्जौ), yoked, joined, connected, joined
to, harnessed, drawn by, (चतुर्-युज्, drawn by four
horses; अश्व-सहस्र-युज्, drawn by a thousand
horses; हयोत्तम-युज्, drawn by the best horses);
yoked or joined together, any one who is joined
or yoked, a yoke-fellow, yoke-mate, companion;
furnished or provided with, filled with, affected by,
possessed of, possessing (e. g. प्रीति-युज्, possessing
pleasure, pleased; काम-युज्, possessing, i. e. grant-
ing desires, cf. धर्म-युज्); exciting, an exciter,
(युङ् भियः, exciter of fear); in couples or pairs,
even, not odd, not single, not separate [cf. अ-युज्];
(क् or ङ्), m. a pair, couple, the number two; a
joiner, one who joins or unites; one who devotes
his time to abstract contemplation, a sage; a measure
of 300 poles (?); युजौ, m. du. the sign of the
zodiac Gemini; the two Aśvins; [cf. Lat. con-jux,
con-jug-is.]
युज = 2. युज्, ‘even,’ ‘not odd,’ in a few comps.

युज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. connected, united, friendly;
related, allied; suitable, fit, fitting, proper; of the same
kind, homogeneous; a kinsman; (अम्), n. union,
connection, relationship; जमदग्नेर् व्रतं युज्-
यम्, N. of a Sāman, (also read युग्यम्.)

युज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being united or joined
or connected with (with inst.); being furnished or
provided with, possessing (with inst.).
